entry.title: I Tried a 7-Day Dopamine Detox: The Hardest Part Wasn’t What I Expected
entry.summary: I thought the hardest part would be not touching my phone. It wasn’t. The real challenge started after I removed the obvious distractions, because my brain immediately tried to replace them with “reasonable” ones: small tasks, quick checks, tiny errands, and endless context switching that felt productive in the moment.
